en: Unsaved exploration progress will be lost. Return to title screen?
zh: 未保存的进度会丢失。确定返回标题画面？

keys: Light 3 world beacons to stabilize the sector.
en: Light 3 world beacons to stabilize the sector.
zh: 点亮 3 座世界信标以稳定区域。

keys: Three timber beams will do. Fell the trees nearby.
en: Three timber beams will do. Fell the trees nearby.
zh: 三根木梁就够了。去砍附近的树。

keys: The ward is steadier. Take this for your trouble.
en: The ward is steadier. Take this for your trouble.
zh: 结界稳定了些。这是给你的报酬。
